title: U.S. postal inspectors shut down website selling counterfeit postage labels
summary: U.S. postal inspectors successfully shut down an illegal website that was selling millions of counterfeit postage labels to consumers, marking a significant enforcement action against postal fraud.
problem_solved: Reports on law enforcement action to combat the distribution and sale of counterfeit postage labels.
why_valuable: Provides public awareness about postal fraud enforcement and protects the integrity of the U.S. postal system.
